$comment: Contract for the CreateExportBatch server-side command (AD-003, AD-039, AD-034 manual only). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_CreateExportBatch
customApi.description: Opens one manual Trail Light export run in Draft (AD-039). Enforces the caller holds Edit on export.generate, upserts al_exportbatch idempotently and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same batch.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
